034_owner_email_delivery.sql -- NOT NULL, ON DELETE RESTRICT explicit. Cannot be 'delete': migration 034 grants service_role only SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on this table (line 445, deliberate -- verification tokens are meant to be tamper-evident), so a sweep DELETE would error, confirmed live (this exact error surfaced while building this fix: 'permission denied for table owner_email_verifications'). Cannot be 'null' either -- tenant_id is NOT NULL. This table DOES use the shared TEST_TENANT_ID (unlike outbound_sends' dedicated fixture), but test/owner-confirm-email.test.ts already deletes its own rows by exact id in its own afterEach -- the generic sweep is redundant when that runs, and structurally cannot help when it doesn't. (The table's own user_id/tenant_id composite FK to users cascades, so no users-side entry is needed.)
